name: media-markdown-converter
description: Convert paper notes and audio recordings to markdown using LLM vision and audio models

scripts.build: tsc && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:linux: tsc && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never
scripts.build:mac: tsc && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.build:win: tsc && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
